rules.note: If the input guardrail tripwire is triggered, the agent must be blocked.
If the input guardrail tripwire is triggered but the agent is not the first, the agent must not be blocked due to this tripwire.
If the output guardrail tripwire is triggered, the output must not be released.
If the output guardrail tripwire is triggered but the agent is not the final one, the output must be released despite the tripwire.
